sentences.en: Many people on Tinder are just looking for a short-term relationship.
sentences.zh: 在 Tinder 上很多人只是想找一段短期关系。

sentences.en: I had forgotten that my short-term memory is terrible.
sentences.zh: 我忘了我的短期记忆很差。

sentences.en: There's a short-term task to be done for our team today.
sentences.zh: 今天我们团队有一个短期任务需要完成。
